            c:RAG = { set_variable = oe_itp_jb_up }

            trigger_event_silently = oe_itp.99

    }
}

        }
        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_itp.12.b
        custom_tooltip = oe_itp.12.b.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            oe_itp_add_claims = { kd = 5 }
            c:VEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_claim_cut target = c:BYZ } }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 35 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_itp.12.c
        custom_tooltip = oe_itp.12.c.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            c:VEN ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_claim_denied target = c:BYZ } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_ven_pact_m }
                change_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m add = -24 }
                clamp_variable = { name = oe_itp_ven_pact_m min = 0 max = 1000 }
            }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
    }
}

oe_itp.13 = { # 抵押期满
    type = country_event
    outcome = neutral
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/trade_market/trade.dds"
    title = oe_itp.13.t
    desc = oe_itp.13.desc
    trigger = { tag = BYZ has_variable = oe_itp_tgt_13 }
    immediate = { oe_ml_take_as = { line = 15 } var:oe_itp_tgt_13 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_itp_r } }
    option = {
        name = oe_itp.13.a
        custom_tooltip = oe_itp.13.a.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            scope:oe_itp_r = {
                set_variable = oe_itp_jb_dn
                add_opinion = { modifier = oe_itp_op_slight target = c:BYZ }
            }
            trigger_event_silently = oe_itp.99
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 50 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_itp.13.b
        custom_tooltip = oe_itp.13.b.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_itp_r = { tag = VEN } } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_ven value = 120 } }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_itp_r = { tag = GEN } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_gen value = 120 }
            }
            add_gold = oe_itp_m5
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 40 modifier = { factor = 2 gold < oe_fin_low_gold } }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_itp.13.c
        trigger = { scope:oe_itp_r = { tag = VEN } has_variable = oe_itp_ven_claims var:oe_itp_ven_claims > 0 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_itp.13.c.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_itp_r = { tag = VEN } } set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_ven value = 120 } }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_itp_r = { tag = GEN } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_itp_t3m_gen value = 120 }
            }
            oe_itp_add_claims = { kd = -10 }
        }
        ai_chance = { base = 10 }
    }
}
